title: Page 7
lines: “你听听，人家个小姑娘比你还懂事。”顾乔成忍不住骂道：“你看人家，不单记事快，脑子也清楚。你呢？只有记仇记得特别好，其他都不成。”
赵小丫差点笑出来，若说周屹天嘴毒，顾乔成也不遑多让。
不过这次周屹天奇蹟似的没恼，反而得意的微扬下巴，伸出手拍了拍赵小丫的脸，“小丫确实很好，所以我定下了。”
顾乔成没好气的瞪着周屹天那只不规矩的手，这是捅破了那张纸，连脸皮都不要了。
赵小丫也因为周屹天突然其来的动作惊了1下，有些怯怯的看向顾乔成。
顾乔成对她的目光，摇了摇头，“我老了，管不住他，他想怎么样就怎么样，不过你别怕，以后若是觉得委屈，爷爷肯定帮你。”
赵小丫眼底闪动着感动。
周屹天不以为然的嗤声，“老头子，你别想跟我抢人，我委屈别人也不会委屈她。”
顾乔成挑了下眉，周屹天似乎忘了，若真出征漠北，去多年，就算想不委屈也得委屈。
他原起了心思，既然周屹天认定，索性让两人成亲，说不准在出征前能怀上孩子，但是又想到战场上风云诡变，若周屹天有个万，赵小丫……两个孩子他都疼，所以最终打消了念头，就让切随缘。
“咱们这去最多十日，我看村子里的人没人敢过来，所以小丫留下来收拾收拾，尤其这屋子的书，等下山之后同搬回京。”
周屹天下子忘了要说的话，与赵小丫交换了同样惊讶的眼神，然后脱口说道：“老头儿，你要跟我们返京？”
顾乔成好气又好笑的看着他，“怎么？不成？”
成！自然是成！周屹天嘴角微扬，这次倒没有毒舌惹顾乔成，免得他又改变主意。
赵小丫的双眼因兴奋而发亮，本以为要花点心思说服，没料到他竟然自己开了口。
“好。”她乖巧的说：“我就在家里收拾，这屋子的书得收拾好几天。”
“慢慢来吧。”顾乔成双手负在身后，“别累着了。”
“老头子，这是我要说的话。”
顾乔成懒得理这个不着调的外孙，转过身，“还不出来。”
“我等会儿便——”
“你别让我改变主意。”
周屹天在心中诅咒了声，这老头竟然还威胁人，偏偏这次挺有用，他不太情愿的从榻上起身。
赵小丫跟着站起来，替他理了理衣服。
周屹天趁着顾乔成背对着没瞧见，低下头吻了下她的脸颊，这才跟在顾乔成身后。
赵小丫摸了摸脸，笑了笑。
顾乔成听到身后的脚步声，微扬了下嘴角。
离京时还以为这辈子不会有返京的日，而这次……他在心中一叹，其实没赵小丫帮腔，他也打定主意返京，毕竟不论周屹天袭爵或赴漠北，他都明白前方的路危险重重，他没在旁看着无法放心。
对于周屹天，他挂心的程度超乎任何人所能想像的，只是他个粗汉子可没脸把关爱总挂在嘴边。
“臭小子。”走下楼时，顾乔成说道：“小丫还小，发乎情，止乎礼。”
周峻天先是一愣，而后意会了顾乔成的意思，耳尖发红，“我又不是禽兽。”
顾乔成的脚步顿，转过头上下看着他，“这倒新鲜了。”
“老头子，你这张嘴真的很讨人厌！”周屹天气急败坏。
顾乔成得意笑，大步离去，“彼此，彼此。”
原预料十天左右会下山的周屹天，在第三日入夜时背着脸苍白的顾乔成进了竹楼。
赵小丫看到身狼狈的他们，心咯噔下。
“无事。”顾乔成被扶坐在厅里的竹椅上，脸色并不好看，但看着赵小丫的眼神清亮，“只是手臂被狼咬了口。”
此次上山运气不好，遇上了狼群，要不是周屹天够狼绝，刀斩杀了狼王，他的手怕是毁了。
顾乔成的手臂被咬下大块肉，深可见骨，流了不少血，虽然止住了，但元气大伤。
因为怕狼会记仇，下山伤人，所以纵使他受了伤，还是坚持让周屹天和周岳赶尽杀绝之后才下山。
看着已包扎妥当的手臂，赵小丫看不出伤势，只能担忧的看向周屹天。
“老头子说无事便无事。”周屹天不让她胡思乱想，口气轻描淡写，“可有吃的？”
赵小丫立刻转身，“等会儿便好。灶上正好烧了些水，你让爷爷梳洗流洗。”
周屹天应了声，让周岳去拿水，自己则不理会顾乔成的反对，硬要将他背回房。
这一路都是他将顾乔成背下山，就算周岳出声帮忙都被他拒绝。
顾乔成看着他的腿，就算周屹天心想要隐瞒，但行走时脚步虚浮骗不了人。
周屹天注意到他的目光，“我的脚没事。”不过就是有些隐隐作痛，他不放在心上。
顾乔成最终挥手拒绝，用着没伤的手搭在他的臂膀上，扶着他回房。
周屹天微敛下眼，也由着他。
不过几步路，顾乔成走得头晕目眩。
他轻呼了口气，这身子只怕暂时无法赶路返京。
平时若无赵小丫随行，以周屹天和周岳的身手，快马加鞭顶多三日便能进京，但如今他就算不想，也知受伤的自己跟赵小丫样只能乖乖坐上马车。
“给顾良送个信，让他来一趟。”如今他受伤，周屹天的腿又不舒爽，要搬回京城，加
上藏书在内的行囊，只靠周岳太勉强。
周屹天将人扶坐在床上，“他现在应该已经在路上了。”
顾乔成挑了下眉。
周屹天不愿意承认自己是不放心赵小丫个人在家，所以飞鸽传书叫顾良来。
顾乔成略显虚弱的靠着床柱，周屹天眼神流转，他就猜到他的心思，好气又好笑，“你是为了小丫？你这脑子是怎么长的？若不是遇上狼群，咱们顶多十天便回，顾良就算赶来也不过早我们几日，有必要吗？”
周屹天不可能承认自己糊涂，大言不惭的说：“你姑且不要想着我是为小丫，你就当咱们爷孙俩难得次心灵相通不成吗？”
顾乔成的回应是不屑的哼。
这个小子平时自傲自己功夫了得，要他带上护卫死活都不愿，如今倒好，为了赵小丫，以往那些执着全成过眼云烟，真是应了那句英雄难过美人关。
他用完好如初的手从衣襟内掏出狼牙，丢向周屹天。
周屹天眼明手快的接过来，牙上犹留血迹，他不由得勾了下嘴角，“老头子，你伤得都快死了竟还有心思拔狼王的牙。”
“给你你就收着。”顾乔成没好气的说：“以后别记挂那虎牙，我既送了人就没收回来的道理。”
“瞧你说的。”周屹天将狼牙塞进衣襟，“我也不会去惦记小丫的东西。”
顾乔成正要说最好，殊不知周屹天接下来的话令他只想把这人打飞。
“反正夫妻体，小丫的就是我的。”
这脸皮，无人能敌了。
顾乔成受伤的隔天下了场雨，天气又冷了几分。
竹楼外表看来雅致，但天气一冷，楼内更显寒冷。
周屹天忍不住唠叨，老头子一个粗人，干么拿这些竹子充当斯文面门，压根不切实际，气得顾乔成不想跟他多言。
周屹天不客气的翻出顾乔成这几年有功夫的大男人不怕冷，不过赵小丫可不同。
赵小丫从不觉得自己娇弱，但她喜欢被他宠着，所以也就由着他折腾，就算看到他因为要找兽皮而将她收拾好的行李全都弄乱，又要重新花精神整饬，她也只是笑着再收拾次。
content_en:
"Listen, this little girl is smarter than you." Gu Qiaocheng couldn't help scolding: "Look at me, not only does she remember things quickly, she also has a clear mind. What about you? She only remembers grudges very well, but nothing else."
Zhao Xiaoya almost laughed out loud. If Zhou Yitian was venomous, Gu Qiaocheng was no less generous.
But this time, Zhou Yitian miraculously didn't feel annoyed. Instead, he raised his chin slightly proudly, stretched out his hand and patted Zhao Xiaoya's face, "Xiaoya is indeed very good, so I made the decision."
Gu Qiaocheng glared at Zhou Yitian's irregular hand angrily, piercing the piece of paper without even losing his face.
Zhao Xiaoya was also startled by Zhou Yitian's sudden movement and looked at Gu Qiaocheng timidly.
Gu Qiaocheng looked at her and shook his head, "I'm old and can't control him. He can do whatever he wants. But don't be afraid. If you feel wronged in the future, grandpa will definitely help you."
Zhao Xiaoya's eyes flashed with emotion.
Zhou Yitian sneered disapprovingly, "Old man, don't try to steal someone from me. I won't wrong her even if I wrong others."
Gu Qiaocheng raised his eyebrows. Zhou Yitian seemed to have forgotten that if he really went to Mobei for many years, he would have to be aggrieved even if he wanted not to be aggrieved.
He thought about it, since Zhou Yitian decided that he would simply let the two get married, and he might not be able to conceive a child before going off to the war, but he also thought about the unexpected changes on the battlefield, and if Zhou Yitian had Wan, Zhao Xiaoya... He felt hurt for both children, so he finally gave up the idea and let Che go.
"We can stay here for ten days at most. I don't think anyone in the village dares to come here, so Xiaoya stays here to pack up, especially the books in this house, and we will move back to Beijing together after we go down the mountain."
Zhou Yi suddenly forgot what he was going to say, exchanged the same surprised look with Zhao Xiaoya, and then blurted out: "Old man, do you want to return to Beijing with us?"
Gu Qiaocheng looked at him angrily and funny, "What? No?"
Done! Of course it works! Zhou Yitian raised the corner of his mouth slightly, but this time he did not use his venomous words to provoke Gu Qiaocheng, lest he change his mind again.
Zhao Xiaoya's eyes lit up with excitement. She thought she would have to put in some effort to persuade, but she didn't expect that he would actually speak on his own.
"Okay." She said obediently, "I'll clean it up at home. It will take several days to clean up the books in this room."
"Take your time." Gu Qiaocheng put his hands behind his back, "Don't be tired."
"Old man, this is what I want to say."
Gu Qiaocheng was too lazy to pay attention to this obscure grandson and turned around, "Don't come out yet."
"I'll do it later-"
"Don't make me change my mind."
Zhou Yitian cursed in his heart. This old man actually threatened others, but it worked this time. He reluctantly got up from the couch.
Zhao Xiaoya stood up and straightened his clothes.
Zhou Yitian took advantage of Gu Qiaocheng's back and lowered his head to kiss her cheek, then followed Gu Qiaocheng.
Zhao Xiaoya touched her face and smiled.
Gu Qiaocheng heard the footsteps behind him and raised the corners of his mouth slightly.
When he left Beijing, he thought he would never return to Beijing in this life, but this time... He sighed in his heart. In fact, without Zhao Xiaoya's help, he made up his mind to return to Beijing. After all, whether Zhou Yitian attacked the king or went to Mobei, he knew that the road ahead was full of dangers, and he couldn't rest assured without watching.
For Zhou Yitian, he was more concerned than anyone could imagine, but he was a rough man and had no shame in talking about caring.
"Bad boy." Gu Qiaocheng said as he walked downstairs: "Xiaoya is still young. She only cares about emotions and politeness."
Zhou Juntian was stunned at first, then realized what Gu Qiaocheng meant, the tips of his ears turned red, "I'm not a beast."
Gu Qiaocheng paused and turned his head to look at him, "This is quite new."
"Old man, your mouth is really annoying!" Zhou Yi said in a panic.
Gu Qiaocheng smiled proudly and strode away, "Each other, each other."
Zhou Yitian, who had expected to go down the mountain in about ten days, carried the pale Gu Qiaocheng into the bamboo building at nightfall on the third day.
Zhao Xiaoya's heart skipped a beat when she saw them in such embarrassment.
"Nothing happened." Gu Qiaocheng was helped to sit on the bamboo chair in the hall. His face was not pretty, but his eyes were clear when he looked at Zhao Xiaoya, "It's just that his arm was bitten by a wolf."
I had bad luck going up the mountain this time and encountered a pack of wolves. If Zhou Yitian hadn't been a master of wolf skills and killed the wolf king with his sword, his hand would have been destroyed.
A large piece of meat was bitten off Gu Qiaocheng's arm, and the bone was visible. He bled a lot. Although it stopped, his vitality was severely damaged.
Because he was afraid that the wolf would hold a grudge and come down the mountain to hurt someone, even though he was injured, he still insisted on letting Zhou Yitian and Zhou Yue kill them all before going down the mountain.
Looking at the well-bandaged arm, Zhao Xiaoya could not tell the extent of the injury and could only look at Zhou Yitian worriedly.
"When the old man says it's nothing, it's nothing." Zhou Yitian stopped her from thinking and said in an understatement, "Is there anything to eat?"
Zhao Xiaoya immediately turned around and said, "It will be ready in a moment. Some water is just boiling on the stove. Let grandpa wash up."
Zhou Yitian responded and asked Zhou Yue to get water, while he ignored Gu Qiaocheng's objection and insisted on carrying him back to his room.
He carried Gu Qiaocheng down the mountain all the way. Even if Zhou Yue offered to help, he refused.
Gu Qiaocheng looked at his legs. Even if Zhou Yitian wanted to hide it, his empty steps when walking could not deceive others.
Zhou Yitian noticed his gaze and said, "My foot is fine." It just hurt a little, but he didn't mind it.
Gu Qiaocheng finally waved his hand to refuse, put his good hand on his arm, and helped him back to his room.
Zhou Yitian lowered his eyes slightly and let him go.
After only a few steps, Gu Qiaocheng felt dizzy.
He breathed a sigh of relief. He was worried that he would not be able to return to Beijing for the time being.
Normally, without Zhao Xiaoya accompanying him, with the skills of Zhou Yitian and Zhou Yue, they would be able to enter Beijing in three days at most. But now, even if he didn't want to, he knew that like Zhao Xiaoya, who was injured, he could only sit on the carriage obediently.
"Send a message to Gu Liang and ask him to come." Now that he was injured and Zhou Yitian's legs were uncomfortable, he had to move back to the capital and join the
Zhou Yue was too reluctant to carry his luggage including books.
Zhou Yitian helped him sit on the bed, "He should be on the way now."
Gu Qiaocheng raised his eyebrows.
Zhou Yitian didn't want to admit that he was worried about Zhao Xiaoya being at home alone, so Fei Ge sent a message to Gu Liang.
Gu Qiaocheng leaned slightly weakly against the bedpost. Zhou Yitian's eyes were moving, and he guessed his thoughts. He was angry and funny, "Are you doing this for Xiaoya? How did you get such a brain? If we hadn't encountered a pack of wolves, we would have been back in ten days at most. Even if Gu Liang came, he wouldn't be too early for us. Is it necessary?"
It was impossible for Zhou Yitian to admit that he was confused, so he said boldly: "Don't think that I am doing it for Xiaoya, just think that our grandfather and grandson have a rare spiritual connection."
Gu Qiaocheng's response was a disdainful snort.
This boy usually prides himself on his martial arts skills and refuses to live or die even if he is asked to bring a bodyguard. But now it is good. For Zhao Xiaoya, all the persistence in the past has become a thing of the past. He really complied with the saying that it is difficult for a hero to be a beauty.
He used his good hand to take out the wolf fang from his clothes and threw it towards Zhou Yitian.
Zhou Yitian took it with clear eyes and quick hands. There were still blood stains on his teeth. He couldn't help but curl his lips, "Old man, you are so injured that you are almost dead and you still have the heart to pull out the Wolf King's teeth."
"Just keep it." Gu Qiaocheng said angrily: "Don't forget about those tiger teeth in the future. Once I give it away, I won't take it back."
"See what you said." Zhou Yitian stuffed the wolf teeth into his clothes, "I won't worry about Xiaoya's things."
Gu Qiaocheng was about to say the best thing, but Zhou Yitian's next words made him just want to beat this person away.
"Anyway, Xiaoya's body is mine."
This face is unmatched by anyone.
The day after Gu Qiaocheng was injured, it rained and the weather got a little colder.
The bamboo building looks elegant on the outside, but when the weather gets cold, it becomes even colder inside.
Zhou Yitian couldn't help nagging, the old man was a rough man, why would he use these bamboos to act as a polite face? It was completely unrealistic, and Gu Qiaocheng was so angry that he didn't want to say anything to him.
Zhou Yitian unceremoniously revealed that Gu Qiaocheng has become a mature man who is not afraid of the cold in recent years, but Zhao Xiaoya is different.
Zhao Xiaoya never felt that she was weak, but she liked to be pampered by him, so she let him do whatever he wanted. Even when she saw that he had messed up all the luggage she had packed because he was looking for animal skins, and had to put his energy into organizing it again, she would just smile and pack it again.
